## CLAUDE-RUNTIME (claude-gateway / claude-custom) — context window: display vs compaction

### (1) DISPLAY chain

Stored `connection.models[].contextWindow` (e.g. 262 144, written by the sync) is **never on this chain**. The number the renderer divides by is the Claude Agent SDK's own belief:

1. SDK subprocess (native `claude` binary) computes per-model `contextWindow` internally and reports it in `result` messages as `modelUsage[<id>].contextWindow` (SDK type: `node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.d.ts:1253`).
2. `packages/shared/src/agent/backend/claude/event-adapter.ts:539-540` — `adaptResult` caches `primaryModelUsage.contextWindow` into `this.cachedContextWindow`; `:566` puts it on the `complete` event's usage.

4. `packages/server-core/src/sessions/SessionManager.ts:20399-20425` (`usage_update`) and `:20338-20353` (`complete`) write `tokenUsage.inputTokens` / `tokenUsage.contextWindow` and forward `usage_update` to the renderer. It divides `inputTokens / contextWindow` (`context-meter-state.ts:83`) — i.e. **API-usage tokens of the last assistant message ÷ SDK-reported window**. Tooltip `FreeFormInput.tsx:2455-2458` shows `used/window` in thousands. The overlay counter (`ChatDisplay.usage-format.ts:52-70`) divides by the same `tokenUsage.contextWindow`.

**What the SDK believes for gateway ids** (extracted from the bundled binary `node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64/claude`, function chain `JE→NKc`): 1M for Fable/1M-beta cases; else `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` env if set **and** the id does not start with `claude-`; else default `200000`. Nessy never sets `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` (repo grep: only inside the SDK's own bundled code). The loopback adapter passes the model id verbatim and translates only token counts (`packages/codex-responses-adapter/src/anthropic/inbound.ts:6` "resolveInboundModel … stripped", `anthropic/outbound.ts:67-83`). 4. **`usageTracker` holds a third window**: seeded once with `getModelContextWindow(model) ?? 200_000` (`claude-agent.ts:790`, `base-agent.ts:626-627`), never updated from SDK reports; consumed by `guardLargeResult` for local tool results (`claude-agent.ts:2015`). - **Compaction visibility**: the wire has `thread/compacted` (`ContextCompactedNotification`, `packages/codex-protocol/generated/ServerNotification.ts:79`), and `CodexEventAdapter.adapt` (`packages/shared/src/agent/backend/codex/event-adapter.ts:197-289`) has **no case for it** — a codex compaction produces no UI event, no `isCompacting`, no info row.

## (3) STALENESS

Non-issue in the strict sense because **nothing consumes it**: when the synced `contextWindow` changes (hourly gateway refresh — `GatewayRuntimeModelFetcher.refreshIntervalMs = 60*60*1000`, `packages/server-core/src/model-fetchers/registry.ts:45-62`, values from `nestor.ts:67` incl. the `NESTOR_GATEWAY_MODEL_WINDOWS` 262 144 fallback at :17-20; or a user edit), no codex session — running or new — picks it up:
- session start: `CodexAgent` constructor passes no contextWindow (`codex-agent.ts:153-154`, `super(config, DEFAULT_CODEX_MODEL)` — the UsageTracker seeds undefined, `base-agent.ts:626-630`);
- runtime payload: `codexDriver.buildRuntime` passes no models/`customModels` (`drivers/codex.ts:72-84`), unlike the Pi driver (`drivers/pi.ts:296-309`);
- mid-session: SessionManager's `updateRuntimeConfig` push of `customModels` with contextWindow (`SessionManager.ts:10735-10758`) reaches only agents implementing it — CodexAgent doesn't.

The only refresh that works is codex's own: every `thread/tokenUsage/updated` re-reports `modelContextWindow`, so within a session the displayed window is always codex-fresh — and always codex's opinion, never the backend catalog's.

## (4) MISMATCHES

1. **Wire-casing bug — recorded input/output tokens are read from keys that don't exist on the pinned contract.** `codex-agent.ts:383-384` and `CodexTokenUsage` (`event-adapter.ts:174-178`) read `last.input_tokens`/`output_tokens` (snake_case), but the bundled binary's generated contract is camelCase: `TokenUsageBreakdown = { totalTokens, inputTokens, cachedInputTokens, ... }` (`packages/codex-protocol/generated/v2/TokenUsageBreakdown.ts:5`). `modelContextWindow` in the *same* payload is read camelCase and matches. Consequence: per contract, every notification records `0` input / `0` output → donut shows 0%, the token-count line (gated `inputTokens > 0`, FreeFormInput.tsx:2840) never appears, and session usage metrics stay zero. Only tests using self-consistent snake_case fixtures (`codex-event-adapter.test.ts:230-236`) cover this; no live/e2e coverage of the shape exists.
2. **Display window ≠ synced catalog window.** Display divides by codex's `modelContextWindow`; the hourly-synced `connection.models[].contextWindow` (262 144 for the gateway qwen models) is never consulted (see §3). If codex reports null for the unknown gateway model id, there is no donut at all despite the catalog knowing the window.
3. **UI threshold is invented and unrelated to the real one.** Codex's composer capability is `contextUsage: {kind:'unavailable', reason:'unsupported'}` (`composer-capabilities.ts:82-105`), so `providerReportsFreshUsage=false` and the meter fabricates a threshold at 77.5% of the window (`context-meter-state.ts:56, 66-67`), turning the donut to warning at 80% of that (≈62% of window). Codex's actual auto-compact limit (`model_auto_compact_token_limit`, internal default) is never read or reported. Consequence: the warning/threshold percentage shown has no relationship to when codex will actually compact.
4. **The offered remedy is a no-op prose turn.** The warning donut is a button submitting `/compact` (FreeFormInput.tsx:2483), which on codex goes out as bare model input (`codex-agent.ts:686, 715`) — the model answers *about* the word "/compact"; nothing compacts. So the UI both mis-predicts compaction and offers an action that cannot perform one.
5. **Compaction events invisible.** `thread/compacted` unhandled in `CodexEventAdapter.adapt` (event-adapter.ts:197-289) → `isCompacting` never true, no `compaction_complete` info row, `ContextUsageSnapshot` never produced for codex (SessionManager:8459 branch dead).
6. **Counter identity (trap check)**: the UI displays `tokenUsage.inputTokens` (SessionManager:20342); codex compacts off its internal accounting with a configurable scope — different counters. `TokenUsage.contextTokens` and `ContextUsageSnapshot.inputTokens` are additionally uninvolved on this runtime (snapshot never filled — consistent with the known Pi-path trap; do not use either as a codex detector).

## (5) CDP-CASE ASSERTIONS

**Display right** (product-written sources):
- On-screen: donut `aria-label` = `chat.contextUsage.label`/`combined` percent (FreeFormInput.tsx:2470-2474), tooltip `used K / window K` (:2454-2458), token-count line `chat.tokensUsed` (:2840-2850).
- Product-written comparand: session store header field `n` (tokenUsage) in `<config>/sessions/<workspaceId>/<sessionId>/session.jsonl` (written by the persistence queue; `StoredSession.tokenUsage`, `packages/shared/src/sessions/storage.ts:225`). Assert after one real turn: `n.inputTokens > 0`, `n.contextWindow` present, and donut percent `=== round(n.inputTokens / n.contextWindow * 100)`. **Predicted today: FAIL on `inputTokens > 0`** (mismatch 1) — that single read simultaneously settles the casing bug and, via `n.contextWindow` presence/value, what codex 0.147.0 reports for `tgpt/*` models (null ⇒ no donut; 262 144 would mean codex knows it, which nothing in the repo supports).
- Note `/context` overlay (`CTX-4` in the archived case table of `docs/testing/cdp-runs/2026-07-30--2026-08-17-run-narratives.md`, still ⬜): codex lacks `requestContextUsage`, so `SessionManager.ts:9460-9470` returns `unsupported` + the (undefined) stored snapshot — legacy totals fallback only.

**Threshold right**:
- There is **no product-written codex-side instrument on a packaged build**: `CODEX_HOME` is `mkdtempSync`'d and `rmSync`'d on teardown (`codex-agent.ts:271`, `:1003`) — the same named gap CMP-N6 records (its row in that archived case table). Record the arm as instrument-less rather than skipped, or point `CODEX_HOME` retention at a kept dir for the case.
- The detector the product itself writes and the feature itself promises: **the context comes back down** — drive the session until codex auto-compacts, then assert `n.inputTokens` at the next turn is far below the prior peak (sequence of session.jsonl reads between turns). This is the AGENTS.md-preferred "source the feature writes" shape (blocked today by mismatch 1 — inputTokens pinned at 0 also destroys this detector; fix or live-verify casing first).
- Negative control proving UI-threshold/compaction unlinkage: at ≥62% window the donut becomes a button; click it and assert the transcript gains an ordinary **assistant turn about "/compact"** and no `Compacted context…` info row — the exact red-run shape CMP-N6 describes.
